unit_cn: Unit 1 School Life 学校生活
source: 上外版(SFLEP)必修第一册 Unit 1 Glossary 真词(跳过 △ 超纲专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填(课本乱码 IPA 不照抄);例句原创、学校生活主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Mrs Peabody gave the class a writing assignment about summer vacation.
words.example_cn: 皮博迪老师给全班布置了一篇关于暑假的写作作业。

words.example_en: The teacher asked the students to be as creative as they could.
words.example_cn: 老师要求学生们尽量发挥创意。

words.example_en: She told us to use proper spelling and grammar in the essay.
words.example_cn: 她叫我们在作文里使用正确的拼写和语法。

words.example_en: Good grammar makes your writing easier to understand.
words.example_cn: 良好的语法能让你的作文更易读懂。

words.example_en: Jim stared at a blank sheet of paper for a long time.
words.example_cn: 吉姆盯着一张白纸看了很久。

words.example_en: Almost everyone in class wrote an essay about the summer vacation.
words.example_cn: 班里几乎每个人都写了一篇关于暑假的作文。

words.example_en: Jim was praised because his story was so imaginative.
words.example_cn: 吉姆因为故事极富想象力而受到表扬。

words.example_en: He had the courage to write something quite different.
words.example_cn: 他有勇气写出一些与众不同的东西。

words.example_en: The teacher said she had some rather harsh words for the class.
words.example_cn: 老师说她有些相当严厉的话要对全班讲。

words.example_en: At the beginning of a new term, everyone felt a little nervous.
words.example_cn: 新学期开始时,大家都有点紧张。

words.meaning_cn: 高级的;年长的;高年级的
words.example_en: Anne was getting ready for her first day of senior high school.
words.example_cn: 安妮正为高中第一天做准备。

words.meaning_cn: 初级的;较年幼的;低年级的
words.example_en: I remember the hopes I had in junior high school.
words.example_cn: 我还记得自己在初中时怀有的希望。

words.example_en: She had to face new classmates, new teachers and new expectations.
words.example_cn: 她得面对新同学、新老师和新的期望。

words.example_en: You may put yourself under pressure to make everything perfect.
words.example_cn: 你可能会给自己施压,想让一切都完美。

words.example_en: There is no such thing as a perfect first day at school.
words.example_cn: 完美的开学第一天是不存在的。

words.example_en: I hope you find comfort in knowing you are not alone.
words.example_cn: 我希望你能从“你并不孤单”中得到安慰。

words.example_en: Being kind and sympathetic can help unhappy classmates feel better.
words.example_cn: 友善而有同情心能帮助不开心的同学好受些。

words.example_en: You will meet such people throughout your school life.
words.example_cn: 在整个学校生活中你都会遇到这样的人。

words.example_en: You will find such people not only at school but throughout your adult life.
words.example_cn: 你不仅在学校,在整个成年生活中也会遇到这样的人。

words.example_en: When you reflect on an unkind comment, try not to take it to heart.
words.example_cn: 当你思量一句不友善的评论时,尽量别往心里去。

words.example_en: An unkind comment often says more about the giver than about you.
words.example_cn: 一句不友善的评论往往更能说明说话人,而非你。

words.example_en: Such behaviour says more about the giver than the receiver.
words.example_cn: 这样的行为更能说明施予者,而非承受者。

words.example_en: There will never be a shortage of kind people in your life.
words.example_cn: 你的人生中善良的人永远不会短缺。

words.meaning_cn: 真诚的;真心的;可信赖的
words.example_en: You will always meet genuine smiles and real friends at school.
words.example_cn: 在学校你总会遇到真诚的笑容和真正的朋友。

words.example_en: As you go forward into this new chapter, stay brave.
words.example_cn: 当你迈入人生新篇章时,要保持勇敢。

words.meaning_cn: (人生或历史的)时期,篇章;章节
words.example_en: Senior high school is a new chapter in your life.
words.example_cn: 高中是你人生的新篇章。

words.phrase_en: the limitations we put on ourselves
words.example_en: We are most often held back by the limitations we put on ourselves.
words.example_cn: 我们常常被自己给自己设下的局限所阻碍。

words.meaning_cn: 难以理解的;令人困惑的
words.example_en: The new timetable was confusing during the first week of school.
words.example_cn: 开学第一周新课表令人困惑。

words.example_en: There was some confusion about which classroom to go to.
words.example_cn: 对于该去哪间教室,大家有些困惑。

words.example_en: He felt some embarrassment when he answered the question wrongly.
words.example_cn: 答错问题时他感到有些难堪。

words.example_en: The teacher gave an immediate reply to my question.
words.example_cn: 老师立刻回答了我的问题。

words.meaning_cn: (在两者间)难以选择,左右为难
words.example_en: She was torn between joining the drama club and the music club.
words.example_cn: 她在加入戏剧社还是音乐社之间难以抉择。

words.example_en: Getting an A on the story was a pleasant surprise for Jim.
words.example_cn: 故事得了A对吉姆来说是个令人愉快的惊喜。

words.example_en: The head teacher will deliver a speech on the first day of term.
words.example_cn: 班主任会在开学第一天发表讲话。

words.example_en: I hope you have adapted well to your new school life.
words.example_cn: 希望你已经很好地适应了新的学校生活。

words.example_en: “I think I'm going to like school here,” Anne announced.
words.example_cn: “我想我会喜欢这里的学校,”安妮宣布道。

words.example_en: Marilla said she would not tolerate rude words about a teacher.
words.example_cn: 玛丽拉说她不会容忍对老师不礼貌的话。

words.example_en: Unkind words say more about the giver than the receiver.
words.example_cn: 不友善的话更能说明说话者,而非听者。

words.example_en: On the first day Anne came home in high spirits.
words.example_cn: 第一天安妮兴高采烈地回到家。

words.example_en: School rules were her biggest concern about senior high school.
words.example_cn: 校规是她对高中最大的担忧。

words.example_en: The new library has many modern facilities for students.
words.example_cn: 新图书馆为学生配备了许多现代化设施。

words.example_en: The self-service borrowing system was very convenient.
words.example_cn: 自助借书系统非常方便。

words.example_en: What makes the school library so attractive to students?
words.example_cn: 是什么让学校图书馆对学生如此有吸引力?

words.example_en: I felt totally relaxed while reading in the quiet library.
words.example_cn: 在安静的图书馆里读书时我感到完全放松。

words.example_en: The school newspaper is conducting an interview about first-week experiences.
words.example_cn: 校报正在就开学第一周的经历进行采访。

words.example_en: New students felt happy to share their experiences about school.
words.example_cn: 新生们乐于分享他们的校园经历。

words.example_en: Zilu was active and courageous in front of the class.
words.example_cn: 子路在全班面前积极而勇敢。

words.example_en: Confucius had many meaningful discussions with his students.
words.example_cn: 孔子和学生有许多有意义的讨论。
